answer: Because the timing is entered against the knoll challenge, the vault audit can replay the haven history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 125 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3346 identities would post 2716 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
